mapper.insert: insert into _animal (animal_id, category_code, category_etc_value, animal_name, animal_color, animal_gender, animal_neuter, animal_age, animal_weight, member_id, animal_regnum, animal_act, animal_social, animal_etc) values (#{animal_id}, #{category_code}, #{category_etc_value}, #{animal_name}, #{animal_color}, #{animal_gender}, #{animal_neuter}, #{animal_age}, #{animal_weight}, #{member_id}, #{animal_regnum}, #{animal_act}, #{animal_social}, #{animal_etc})

insert into _image (image_id, image_type, image_sequence, image_src) values
(#{li.image_id}, #{li.image_type}, #{li.image_sequence}, #{li.image_src})
mapper.select: select count(animal_id) from _animal where animal_id = #{animal_id} limit 1
select count(animal_id) from _animal where animal_id = #{animal_id} and animal_status != 6 and member_id = #{member_id} limit 1

select a.animal_id, a.category_etc_value, a.animal_name, date_format(a.animal_regdate, '%Y-%m-%d') as animal_regdate, c.category_type, c.category_value, m.member_name, ac.common_value as animal_status_value from _animal a join _category_data c on a.category_code = c.category_code join _member m on a.member_id = m.member_id join _common ac on a.animal_status = ac.common_code where ac.common_column = 'animal_status' and a.animal_status != 6 and a.member_id = #{member_id}

select a.animal_id, a.category_etc_value, a.animal_name, date_format(a.animal_regdate, '%Y-%m-%d') as animal_regdate, c.category_type, c.category_value, m.member_name, m.road_address, ac.common_value as animal_status_value from _animal a join _category_data c on a.category_code = c.category_code join _member m on a.member_id = m.member_id join _common ac on a.animal_status = ac.common_code where ac.common_column = 'animal_status' and a.animal_status != 6

select a.animal_id, a.category_etc_value, a.animal_name, a.animal_color, a.animal_gender, a.animal_neuter, a.animal_age, a.animal_weight, a.member_id, a.animal_regdate, a.animal_status, a.animal_regnum, a.animal_act, a.animal_social, a.animal_etc, a.adpt_member, a.animal_reason, c.category_value, c.category_code, c.category_type, c.category_parent, i.image_id, i.image_type, i.image_sequence, i.image_src, h.health, h.health_check, v.vaccine, v.vaccine_check from _animal a join _category_data c on a.category_code = c.category_code join _image i on a.animal_id = i.image_id join _animal_health h on a.animal_id = h.animal_id join _animal_vaccine v on a.animal_id = v.animal_id left join _adpt ad on a.animal_id = ad.animal_id where a.animal_id = #{animal_id} and a.animal_status != 6 order by i.image_sequence asc

select a.animal_id, a.category_etc_value, a.animal_name, a.animal_color, a.animal_gender, a.animal_neuter, a.animal_age, a.animal_weight, a.member_id, a.animal_regdate, a.animal_status, a.animal_regnum, a.animal_act, a.animal_social, a.animal_etc, a.adpt_member, a.animal_reason, c.category_value, c.category_code, c.category_type, c.category_parent, i.image_id, i.image_type, i.image_sequence, i.image_src, h.health, h.health_check, v.vaccine, v.vaccine_check, ad.* from _animal a join _category_data c on a.category_code = c.category_code join _image i on a.animal_id = i.image_id join _animal_health h on a.animal_id = h.animal_id join _animal_vaccine v on a.animal_id = v.animal_id left join _adpt ad on a.animal_id = ad.animal_id where a.animal_id = #{animal_id} and a.animal_status != 6 and ad.adpt_status != 4 order by i.image_sequence asc

insert into _image (image_id, image_type, image_sequence, image_src) values

insert into _animal_health (animal_id, health, health_check) values
(#{animal_id}, #{h.health}, #{h.health_check})
on duplicate key update health_check = values(health_check)
mapper.update:
insert into _animal_vaccine (animal_id, vaccine, vaccine_check) values
(#{animal_id}, #{v.vaccine}, #{v.vaccine_check})
on duplicate key update vaccine_check = values(vaccine_check)
mapper.insert: insert into _adpt (adpt_id, animal_id, adpt_intro, adpt_etc, member_id) values (concat(#{adpt_id}, lpad(ifnull((select max(adpt_ai) from (select adpt_ai from _adpt) as tempAdpt), 0) + 1, 6, '0')), #{animal_id}, #{adpt_intro}, #{adpt_etc}, #{member_id})
mapper.select: select a.*, ad.*, m.*, cm.common_value as adpt_status_value, c.* from _animal a join _adpt ad on a.animal_id = ad.animal_id join _member m on a.member_id = m.member_id join _category_data c on a.category_code = c.category_code join _common cm on ad.adpt_status = cm.common_code where cm.common_column = 'adpt_status' and a.animal_status in (2, 3, 4) and ad.adpt_status != 4 and ad.member_id = #{member_id}

select a.*, ad.*, m.*, cm.common_value as adpt_status_value, c.* from _animal a join _adpt ad on a.animal_id = ad.animal_id join _member m on a.member_id = m.member_id join _category_data c on a.category_code = c.category_code join _common cm on ad.adpt_status = cm.common_code where cm.common_column = 'adpt_status' and a.animal_status in (2, 3, 4) and ad.adpt_status != 4

select a.animal_id, a.category_etc_value, a.animal_name, a.animal_color, a.animal_gender, a.animal_neuter, a.animal_age, a.animal_weight, a.member_id, a.animal_regdate, a.animal_status, a.animal_regnum, a.animal_act, a.animal_social, a.animal_etc, a.adpt_member, c.category_value, c.category_code, c.category_type, c.category_parent, i.image_id, i.image_type, i.image_sequence, i.image_src, h.health, h.health_check, v.vaccine, v.vaccine_check, ad.* from _animal a join _category_data c on a.category_code = c.category_code join _image i on a.animal_id = i.image_id join _animal_health h on a.animal_id = h.animal_id join _animal_vaccine v on a.animal_id = v.animal_id left join _adpt ad on a.animal_id = ad.animal_id where a.animal_status != 6 order by i.image_sequence asc

select a.animal_id, a.category_etc_value, a.animal_name, a.animal_color, a.animal_gender, a.animal_neuter, a.animal_age, a.animal_weight, a.member_id, a.animal_regdate, a.animal_status, a.animal_regnum, a.animal_act, a.animal_social, a.animal_etc, a.adpt_member, c.category_value, c.category_code, c.category_type, c.category_parent, i.image_id, i.image_type, i.image_sequence, i.image_src, h.health, h.health_check, v.vaccine, v.vaccine_check, ad.* from _animal a join _category_data c on a.category_code = c.category_code join _image i on a.animal_id = i.image_id join _animal_health h on a.animal_id = h.animal_id join _animal_vaccine v on a.animal_id = v.animal_id join _adpt ad on a.animal_id = ad.animal_id where a.animal_status != 6 and ad.adpt_status = 2 order by ad.adpt_regdate desc limit 400

select a.*, c.*, i.*, h.*, v.*, ad.*, m.* from _animal a join _category_data c on a.category_code = c.category_code join _image i on a.animal_id = i.image_id join _animal_health h on a.animal_id = h.animal_id join _animal_vaccine v on a.animal_id = v.animal_id join _adpt ad on a.animal_id = ad.animal_id join _member m on a.member_id = m.member_id where a.animal_status != 6 and ad.adpt_status = 2
and floor(a.category_code/1000) = 1
and floor(a.category_code/2000) = 1
and floor(a.category_code/3000) = 1
and a.category_code = #{category_code}
and ad.adpt_id like concat('ADPT-',#{location},'-%-______-______')
and ad.adpt_id like concat('ADPT-', #{location}, '-', #{location_detail}, '-%')
and (ad.adpt_id like concat('%', #{searchWord}, '%') or a.animal_name like concat('%', #{searchWord}, '%'))
order by ad.adpt_regdate desc
order by ad.adpt_regdate asc
order by ad.adpt_regdate desc
select count(member_id) from _adpt_counsel where animal_id = #{animal_id} and member_id = #{member_id} limit 1

select adc.animal_id, adc.member_id, adc.counsel_subdate, adc.counsel_procdate, adc.counsel_status, a.animal_name, ad.adpt_id, cd.category_value, cd.category_type from _adpt_counsel adc join _animal a on adc.animal_id = a.animal_id join _adpt ad on adc.animal_id = ad.animal_id join _category_data cd on a.category_code = cd.category_code where ad.adpt_status = 2 and a.animal_status not in (1, 4, 5, 6) and a.member_id = #{member_id}
